summary: The overflow test does not verify the full AC1 stream-length and maximum-read contract
evidence: AC1 requires coverage "for reads up to and including the maximum size the transport's read buffer can hold" and requires that "the accumulated stream length after the operation never exceeds UCI_SIM_MAX_PACKET." P6 instead proposes a smaller second chunk, "e.g. UCI_SIM_MAX_PACKET - 4," and explicitly says dev->slen is "not directly observable"; its assertions cover only no crash/error/hang and clean teardown, so neither the maximum-size read nor the post-operation length bound is verified.

summary: P4 omits a production file that its description requires modifying
evidence: P4 lists only "Files: [src/handlers/uci_sim_handlers.c]", but item 5 explicitly requires adding a guard and deleting a write block in "src/model/uci_sim_device.c".

summary: The declared dependencies do not enforce P4's stated ordering after P2
evidence: P2 and P4 both modify src/handlers/uci_sim_handlers.c, P4 declares "Dependencies: []", while the ordering rationale explicitly states "P4 is ordered after P2 ... sequencing avoids any chance of a merge conflict in a real dev loop."

summary: The reset-validation tests omit the previously accepted invalid value 0
evidence: P5 changes the existing reset request from 0x00 to 0x01, but the new invalid-value test sends only "payload[0] = 0x02". AC4 requires every value other than 1 to be rejected, so the known regression case 0x00 is no longer directly exercised.
